verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no feature for exporting stored scraped data or job configurations to migrate to another provider. Reader works as a request/response API that returns markdown or JSON per call. The prebuilt open-source container image (self-hosting) and standard response formats reduce lock-in, but they are adjacent rather than an export or migration capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export my scraped data and job configurations in a portable format to migrate to another provider without lock-in
